title: A Physics-Informed Statistical Learning Model for Long-Term Fragmentation Cloud Propagation
summary: This paper introduced a Hierarchical Generative Density Model (HGDM) for the long-term propagation of orbital fragmentation clouds. Validation against high-fidelity Monte Carlo simulations showed that the proposed surrogate accurately reproduces the dominant multidimensional structures of propagated clouds while consistently outperforming classical band-formation approximations based on independent angular variables.
